failures.failed_witness: The first closeout-builder preflight trimmed the leading Git porcelain space and then sliced one character from the first filename, stopping before packet generation.
failures.passing_witness: The corrected preflight accepted only the four declared final tooling paths at the unchanged evidence head.
failures.recovery: Split each status row into status and path fields rather than slicing a fixed offset after global whitespace normalization.
failures.recurrence_guard: Never combine whole-output strip with fixed-column porcelain slicing.
failures.rollback: No closeout artifact existed and the evidence head remained unchanged.
failures.sibling_recommendation: Parse porcelain records structurally or use zero-delimited output.

failures.failed_witness: The first closeout build used git diff to construct its final-delta manifest and therefore omitted untracked closeout files, producing only one manifest entry.
failures.passing_witness: The corrected final-delta manifest covers every intended evidence-to-final owner path except its declared self-exclusions.
failures.recovery: Enumerate exact modified and untracked final paths with porcelain --untracked-files=all, then rebuild the delta, owner manifest, seal, and baton counts before staging.
failures.recurrence_guard: Use Git status or a declared allowlist when a precommit manifest must include untracked files.
failures.rollback: The incorrect manifests were never staged or committed and are replaced additively in the same unsealed worktree.
failures.sibling_recommendation: Treat working-tree delta discovery and tracked diff discovery as distinct lifecycle surfaces.

failures.failed_witness: The first bounded lint pass over the new final builder, canonical validator, and final tests reported six findings: import ordering, two unused imports, and a repeated startswith form.
failures.passing_witness: The isolated corrected final-file Ruff scope returned All checks passed.
failures.recovery: Apply the five safe Ruff fixes, patch the one remaining prefix-tuple expression, and rerun only the new final-file lint scope.
failures.recurrence_guard: Lint newly added lifecycle files before rebuilding their manifests and seal.
failures.rollback: All fixes remained uncommitted owner-file edits and changed no evidence anchor.
failures.sibling_recommendation: Treat each newly materialized lifecycle tool as a new lint scope rather than assuming earlier scope coverage.

failures.failed_witness: A narrow pre-canonical static preflight found that the validator's security rule classified every function named loads as unsafe, producing thirteen false positives for ordinary JSON parsing before the canonical aggregate was invoked.
failures.passing_witness: The corrected rule distinguishes json.loads from explicitly dangerous deserialization surfaces while retaining the bounded AST review.
failures.recovery: Qualify attribute calls and restrict the rule to eval, exec, os.system, pickle.loads, marshal.loads, and yaml.load, then seal an additive validator correction before the one canonical invocation.
failures.recurrence_guard: Preflight validator definitions narrowly before consuming a one-shot aggregate and match qualified call names rather than generic method names.
failures.rollback: The retained prior content seal remains a single-parent ancestor; no canonical receipt existed and no canonical credit was consumed.
failures.sibling_recommendation: Test security-rule specificity against known-safe standard-library calls before the terminal gate.
